sloka: तस्मात् गृहीत्वा वैदेहीम् शर पाणिः धनुर् धरः ।गुहाम् आश्रय शैलस्य दुर्गाम् पादप संकुलाम् ॥३-२४-१२॥
transliteration: tasmāt gṛhītvā vaidehīm śara pāṇiḥ dhanur dharaḥ ।guhām āśraya śailasya durgām pādapa saṁkulām ॥3-24-12॥

translations.english: Therefore, take shelter along with Sita in the inaccessible mountain cave, overgrown with trees, ready with your bow and arrows.
